230.5.1.10(1).explanation: The bicycle parking rules in Section 230.5 apply to all bicycle parking spaces.

230.5.1.10(10).explanation: Long-term and short-term bicycle parking spaces may be provided as stacked bicycle parking spaces.

230.5.1.10(11).explanation: Bicycle Zone 1 is the area bounded by the Humber River, Lawrence Ave., Victoria Park Ave. and Lake Ontario; Bicycle Zone 2 is the rest of the City.

230.5.1.10(12).explanation: A building needing 5 or more long-term bicycle parking spaces must provide a bicycle maintenance facility at least 1.8 metres long, 2.6 metres wide and 1.9 metres of vertical clearance.

230.5.1.10(13).explanation: At least 5 percent of required long-term bicycle parking spaces must be oversized spaces, rounded down, and not stacked or vertical.

230.5.1.10(14).explanation: The aisle to bicycle parking spaces must be unobstructed and at least 2.5 metres wide for stacked or oversized spaces and 1.8 metres wide otherwise, except inside an ancillary garden or laneway suite building.

230.5.1.10(15).explanation: Where 8 or more long-term bicycle parking spaces are required, at least 40 percent of them, rounded up, must not be stacked above another space or placed vertically on a wall or device.

230.5.1.10(16).explanation: Bicycle parking in a building needs a direct, unobstructed, marked passageway from a street or lane, not over soft landscaping; ramps and elevators are allowed. Ancillary garden or laneway suite buildings are excepted.

230.5.1.10(2).explanation: A fractional number of required bicycle parking spaces is rounded up to the next whole number.

230.5.1.10(3).explanation: Long-term bicycle parking is for occupants or tenants of a building; short-term bicycle parking is for visitors.

230.5.1.10(4).explanation: A bicycle parking space is at least 1.8 metres long, 0.6 metres wide and 1.9 metres high (other sizes apply to vertical, stacked, staggered and oversized spaces).

230.5.1.10(5).explanation: An area with bicycle parking needs a vertical clearance of at least 2.4 metres for stacked spaces and 1.9 metres otherwise.

230.5.1.10(6).explanation: Long-term bicycle parking spaces must be located in a building.

230.5.1.10(7).explanation: A building with non-dwelling uses needing long-term bicycle parking must provide universal shower and change facilities: none under 5 spaces, 1 for 5 to 60, 2 for 61 to 120, 3 for 121 to 180, 4 above 180.

230.5.1.10(8).explanation: A bicycle parking space must be on the same lot as the use it serves.

230.5.1.10(9).explanation: Required long-term bicycle parking may be on the first or second storey or on below-ground levels (each used at least 50% for bicycle parking before the next level down), in the zone categories listed.
